ConsoleXChannel.what: The fully featured ConsoleX channel strip, the biggest Airwindows console.
ConsoleXChannel.sound: Two big-console dynamics sections in one. Bands are tight and punchy when used and sound like nothing is there when flat. Turning Top dB up adds air-distortion loudness.
ConsoleXChannel.use: One on every channel, unity gain into a ConsoleXBuss on the 2-buss.

controls.Highpas: Highpass. Fully down is off; opening it adds supersonic-aware filtering through the plugin.
controls.Lowpass: Lowpass. Fully down is off; opening it filters ultrasonics and tames aliasing.
controls.Fire: Gain/dynamics balance on the Fire (highs) band.
controls.Stone: Gain/dynamics balance on the Stone (lows) band.
controls.Range: Where the Stone and Fire bands split.
controls.Tr Reso: Treble band Q (narrower when turned up).
controls.Top dB: Top level, setting the apparent peak loudness (Discontinuity).

ConsoleXBuss.what: The ConsoleX buss: the same strip, decoding the channels' output on the 2-buss.
ConsoleXBuss.sound: Two big-console dynamics sections in one. Bands are tight and punchy when used and sound like nothing is there when flat. Turning Top dB up adds air-distortion loudness.
ConsoleXBuss.use: One on the 2-buss, after ConsoleXChannel plugins. Keep unity gain between channel and buss.

controls.Highpas: Highpass. Fully down is off; opening it adds supersonic-aware filtering through the plugin.

controls.Stone: Gain/dynamics balance on the Stone (lows) band.
controls.Range: Where the Stone and Fire bands split.
controls.Tr Reso: Treble band Q (narrower when turned up).
controls.Top dB: Top level, setting the apparent peak loudness (Discontinuity).

ConsoleXPre.what: Just the tone shaping from ConsoleX, without the console processing.
ConsoleXPre.sound: Two big-console dynamics sections in one. Bands are tight and punchy when used and sound like nothing is there when flat. Turning Top dB up adds air-distortion loudness.
ConsoleXPre.use: Before and after ToTape on heavy channels, to shape the sound going to and coming back from the tape.

ConsoleHChannel.what: The ConsoleH channel strip, the Airwindows console for hip-hop and music reinvention.
ConsoleHChannel.sound: Adaptable and big. Almost everything drops out of circuit when set flat or to zero, so it forms itself to your sounds. Includes a rainbow-dot peak meter.
ConsoleHChannel.use: On every channel, with unity gain into a ConsoleH buss. Works for sculpting dynamics, re-amping and rescuing soft-synth tracks.

controls.More: Adds a fat 'More' boost (TapeHack2-style) on the channel.

ConsoleHPre.what: Just the tone shaping from ConsoleH, and dual mono.
ConsoleHPre.sound: Adaptable and big. Almost everything drops out of circuit when set flat or to zero, so it forms itself to your sounds. Includes a rainbow-dot peak meter.
ConsoleHPre.use: Tone shaping only, without the console processing.

controls.More: Adds a fat 'More' boost (TapeHack2-style) on the channel.

ConsoleX2Channel.what: A ConsoleX2 channel strip with four-band EQ, dynamics and filters.
ConsoleX2Channel.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only: there is no upstream manual page yet.
ConsoleX2Channel.use: On a channel in the ConsoleX2 system.

ConsoleX2Pre.what: The tone shaping from ConsoleX2, without the console processing.
ConsoleX2Pre.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only: there is no upstream manual page yet.

ConsoleX3.what: A ConsoleX3 strip, switchable between channel and buss.

ConsoleX3.use: On a channel or the buss in the ConsoleX3 system.

controls.Cha/Bus: Switches between channel and buss behaviour.
